facts.claim: Celebrity Ascent (Celebrity Cruises): Entered service 2023; 141,420 GT; 3260 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Edge class.
Discover Celebrity Ascent, our newest cruise ship. View the award-winning luxury cruise ship's deck plan, staterooms, dining options, things to do and upcoming sailings.
Celebrity Ascent is an Edge-class cruise ship owned by Celebrity Cruises.
She is the sister ship of Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, and Celebrity Beyond.

catalogSpecs.description: Edge-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2023; 141,420 GT; approx. 3,260 guests at double occupancy.
